batting.name: S Dhawan
batting.dismissal: c KP Pietersen b S Nadeem

batting.name: Q de Kock
batting.dismissal: c AJ Finch b KV Sharma

batting.name: M Vijay
batting.dismissal: c DW Steyn b DJG Sammy

batting.name: KP Pietersen
batting.dismissal: c DJG Sammy b DW Steyn

batting.name: KD Karthik
batting.dismissal: c KL Rahul b DW Steyn

balls.text: oops! The yorker ends up a full toss and Finch has mauled it over cow corner. Pulls off his helmet and has the look of a man satisfied with his work. Unadkat looks heartbroken with the mistake.
backs away and Unadkat fires it wide outside off, it's too far away for Finch to connect and just inside the wide line too. This has been a brilliant final over
that's good work from Unadkat. Sends down a yorker that tails in at him while Warner was moving outside leg. Flicked into the leg side again
that's the slower ball, dragged down short. Finch heaves it down to deep midwicket as well
skips down the track and turns it into a yorker, flicks it away to deep midwicket
finds the yorker as he follows the batsman making room, single down to long-on
skips down the ground and belts the full toss down the ground. Murderous hit from Warner
it came off once, but this time the ball sneaks through his legs while he was looking to slog sweep as a right hander. So switch hit tally, one six. one dot
moves outside leg and carves a low full toss to the sweeper, who fumbles and allows for the second. Shukla was the man there
searing yorker on middle and leg, Finch inside edges it to his pads and rotates strike
finds the yorker just outside off and Warner slaps it down the ground for his fifty
switch hit warning! This was a low full toss on off stump, Warner changed his grip and swept it right-handed over short fine leg, which was short third man until a second ago
low full toss outside off, Finch does what he has been doing so often. Backs away and hammers it over the boundary. This time the crowd over extra cover scurries to return the ball
the slower ball goes short and Finch has mauled it to the midwicket boundary. Looks like they wont need Sammy today
told you he's good at that! Unadkat goes offside as he sees Finch making room, but he flays his bat at the ball and though one of his hands comes off the bat, it is sliced to the point boundary
saw the batsman making room and slips in a slower ball, Finch adjusts well enough and helps it away to the fine leg boundary
bottom hand comes off the bat as he looks to tear the leather off the ball. Shortish and angled in on off stump, a little too close for the pull and it was the change of pace again

slower ball, dug in short on leg stump. Warner pulls to deep square leg and he decides on a second and makes it rather easily in the end. The throw was a little wayward and though he had slipped a little, Warner is quick enough to be safe

fired in full as he follows the batsman darting outside leg. Finch's footwork this time is good enough to smash it down the ground. Duminy does extremely well at long-on to keep that to two. It was hit very powerfully
he's pulling the over back big time. Finch was setting up outside leg and he followed him with a very full delivery. Goes for the sweep but is a little slow on it
pushed to long-off as Nadeem hits the yorker perfect this time
this time he misses his length and Warner has swept him mightily into the stands behind square leg. Sunk down into his knees and swung the arms quite freely. That was massive
well bowled this, fired in on the base of middle and keeps Finch to a single into extra cover
finds the blockhole first up on leg stump, dug out to long-on

he's miscued this. It was fullish and outside off, he had got into the shot too early and it ends up a difficult skier around the point region. Tiwary is the man under it but he does not look any degree of comfortable. He had passed it and then has to reaches out with his hands and spills it. That's his second drop
Duminy tries at long-on, rushes to his left and pulls out a desparing dive but this was always heading for the boundary. Full toss in the hitting arc and Warner has dismissed it
low full toss outside off, pushed down to long-off
length and outside off, Warner clears his front leg and thumps it down to long-off
full toss outside off, Warner lashes it through the covers but there is protection in the deep. The yorkers aren't coming out right for him
affords no room with a length ball on leg stump, Finch opens the face to pick up a single into the covers
shortish and outside off, Warner clears his front leg and forehands it down to long-on who has to dive to his right
slower ball on and around off stump, Finch dabs it to third man
that's the best of the lot! Overpitched outside off and Finch has come down on it with a straight bat and blitzed it through the covers. Just skims away
and he celebrates that stroke with a bit of cheek. It was shortish and on off stump, Finch waited and waited and chopped it so fine to the third man boundary. That's his fifty
slower ball, picked up and hoisted over long-on. Bent his knees and slogged it away cleanly
full and outside off, Finch has laced it wide of long-off for a couple.
miss it once, my fault. Tempt me again, I'll whack you to the square leg boundary. Full toss angling into the pads, Warner finds release with an efficient flick. Time out now
low full toss outside off, Warner bunts it to short cover
full on off stump, Finch drills it down the ground to long-off
he walks at him and gets struck flush on the pads. It was a full toss tailing in. Warner goes for the flick but can't connect. Another opportunity missed
backs away and cuts into the covers. Off the bottom of the bat again, despite this being a little short and he'd manufactured some room
fullish on off stump, Finch dabs behind point. Pace off the ball is not allowing the batsmen to time the ball

gets this into the blockhole on off stump, Warner pushes to mid-off. That's an excellent start from Shukla, only two off the over. Warner is 18 off 25. He's frustrated and shows it by tossing his gloves away in disgust
he's keeping things tight here. Warner wants to break free as he backs away to cut the slower, length ball. Point is in the way again
full and on the pads, Warner can't pick it away
fullish and outside off, Warner can't beat point again
shortish but Warner has to wait ages for it to reach him, pulls to deep midwicket and they scamper across for a well-run couple
good length and on middle and off, Warner stays back and steers it to point
fullish and on leg stump, Warner keeps his front leg out of the way and slaps it down to long-on. Right off the bottom of the bat
full and just outside off, Finch clears his front leg and drills into the covers
it's the offcutter again, dug in short. Finch has to wait and even when he pulls he can't beat short fine leg
he was walking down the pitch, but Shami bangs it in short. Warner adjusts and unleashes a pull to deep square leg
full and tailing in on leg, Finch flicks it to deep square leg
full offcutter on leg stump, Warner finds long-on
another slower ball, on a good length on middle and leg. Warner pushes it down to long-on
just a little more bounce than Warner thought. He was on the front foot and looking to lash it through the covers but is beaten
cramped for room as he tucks the back of a length ball to midwicket
slower ball on off stump, Finch dabs it in front of point and his Australia opening partner was wise to the single
down the track and pushed down to long-off
good length ball on off stump, steered down to short third man
a little more pitched up on leg stump, Warner blocks
pushed through on middle and leg, nudged away sqyuare

I've seen him do that a couple of times. The bowler saw him making room outside leg and fired it wide outside off. But Finch reaches out, the bottom hand comes off the bat and yet he blasts it over extra cover
goes back and works it a little wide of where mid-on would have been. JP has to do the fielding himself
cut away to the sweeper as this was flat and on off stump
flighted on leg stump, he skips down the track but gets struck on the pads as he was looking to flick
that's been powerfully pulled but Duminy at deep midwicket is a more than handy fielder. Nadeem is not offering anything in the half of the batsman
he waits a little longer and cuts it dead square to the fielder in the deep
pushed through short and on off stump, Warner punches towards extra
shortish and on middle, Warner exhibits a short-armed pull to square leg
shortish and angled into him, Finch moved outside leg and cuts it behind point. Unadkat was the sweeper and he pulls it back right on the boundary
holds in the pitch a little more as Finch looks to nudge it through midwicket. Lobs up in the air back to the bowler but he can't get around Warner quick enough to have a chance
good length ball on and around middle, he backs away and punches to long-off
he's scared the bowler into darting a short ball through and he waits on it and pulls to deep midwicket
flighted on off stump, he defends
whoa! That's emphatic! Chips down the track and drops this into the second tier behind long-on. Reached the pitch and punished it
pushes it through full on middle, but Finch was content on the back foot as he dabs it into the point region
flighted into the pads, Warner clips through midwicket
shortish and outside off, he backs away and cuts through the covers

dropped by DK! It was a massive edge and so a pretty sizeable deflection. The extra bounce from Nadeem doesn't allow for the punch through the covers that Warner was looking for. That needed to have been a reflex catch
shortish and outside off, Warner is back and punches to point

he's gone now and Dhawan cannot believe he has top-edged such an innocuous delivery! It was short and sliding well down leg, should have been pummeled over the fine leg boundary but instead big KP runs back and takes a simple grab over his shoulder. That should tell us something about the durability of his hands
good length on off stump, he goes back and pushes into the covers
fullish offcutter on the stumps, Finch drops and runs and that takes us into the time out
pushes him back on middle and leg, Dhawan turns it around to fine leg
Why are they feeding his strength? Half-tracker with width and Dhawan has thumped it through point to bring up the fifty
skips down the track but Unadkat has pulled all the pace off it and keeps the batsman honest
another slower ball, this one pitched up on off stump. Finch defends with an open face and races across to the other end
back of a length on off stump, slower than normal, Dhawan punches in front of point for a single
full toss on leg stump, Finch can't get it past square leg. Lucky escape
good length ball on and around middle, Finch is stuck in the crease as he looks to defend

he had about three chances and Tiwary has dropped it at poiint. Not the best ball, it was inviting the cut again and Dhawan obliges. The fielder has to step to his left and comes just under his chest. But he juggles it and then down it goes

one-bounce four behind point! Parnell is offering freebies and the Sunrisers captain is accepting them gleefully. Shorter and wider than the previous one in the over and Dhawan does not hold back with the cut
that's over the ropes! It was length and sliding down leg, Dhawan was on his front foot and swiveled to help it on it's way.
do not bowl there to him. Short and wide and Dhawan lashes it through point. Too well hit for the fielder inside the circle
back of a length on off stump, Finch guides it to point and has to send his partner back as he sees the fielder race up to the ball
offcutter again but this time it's short and wide. Finch knows there is no third man and cuts it away to the boundary. Simply done
good length ball just outside off, Finch comes forward and hits it on the up into the covers
goes fuller on off stump, Finch stands and slaps it down the ground. Comes off the bottom the bat a bit which allows long-off to tap it back into the field
slower short ball and Finch was completely fooled. It was the offcutter and it bounces over the stumps.
he's thrown caution to the winds and his risk comes off. Mid-off was up and he launches the a length ball over his head. Hadn't timed it anywhere near well and the bat face opened on impact too
seeks the blockhole and finds it just about, Dhawan digs it out
fullish and around off stump, pushes down the ground to mid-off
full and a little too straight and Dhawan flicks it away to deep square leg. That's the Jayasuriya shot, not quite the same kind of timing this time though
closes the face of the bat too early on this short of a length delivery, gets the leading edge to point
shortish and just a shade outside off, Dhawan goes back in his crease and punches it in front of point with an open face. Pierces the gap and the timing takes care of the rest
back of a length and on middle and leg, Finch nudges to short fine leg. Parnell goes down in his followthrough, but is brisk in getting back up

width on offer and Dhawan has lashed it over the head of cover. Wasn't really all that short but it's a pretty true pitch with the new ball still in operation and the batsman trusted the pace and bounce and hit through the line
length ball angled into him a little too much, flicked behind square leg
fullish and on middle, Dhawan pushes to mid-off nicely
that could have been a lovely delivery for the right-hander, but it's Dhawan on strike. Back of a length and down leg
full and creeping in at him, Dhawan adjusts for it as he clips to mid-on. Kept his front foot out of the way of the bat
good length ball, tailing in on middle and off. It straightens off the deck and gets an inside edge off a tentative defensive push. Single into the off side
back of a length on and around middle, Dhawan seems hurried as he looks to push down the ground. Finch calls him through for a single as the ball wanders wide of the keeper

flatter and quicker and again, Finch goes back and picks it away. KP chases after it and tries to pull it back gingerly with his injured hand. Doesn't succeed the first time and his slide has pushed the boundary rope back and on the second touch, his feet were beyond where the advertising skirtings were and that's a four
flighted and slid down the pads, Finch goes the sweep and misses again
flighted and drifting onto the pads, Finch looks to nurdle it around the corner but doesn't connect. Optimistic leg before appeal ensues
angled across him on a shortish length and Dhawan waits on it and cuts through point
flatter delivery that goes on with the arm, Dhawan had room but he mistimes the cut
flighted a bit more on off stump, but Dhawan is happy to camp on the back foot and chop into the covers
kept to a good length on middle, Dhawan goes back and blocks
gets in the yorker on off stump, JP can only punch it all along the ground to long-off. Steyn gets the ball and doesn't even bother throwing.
he walks down and smashes the low full toss over long-off! JP Duminy, hit one more of those and we have our first Super Over of the IPL
comes down again but the low full toss can only be hit down to long-off
goes for the yorker again but this was a full toss with ample width, Tiwary has skipped down the track and smashed it over point. What a shot!
what a time to bowl a yorker! JP's in immense form and yet he's been duped. Goes for the whack through the on side and gets stuck on the back boot
slower ball well outside off, Tiwary reaches out and pushes it into the covers. Had he left that it would have been a wide
finds the yorker on leg stump, Tiwary was backing away and gets a thick outside edge that goes down to deep third man. They've taken the single. JP will not be on strike, with 20 off 6 required
low full toss just outside off, JP steers it to extra cover for a single
JP is in red hot form! This was short and wide and he hoists it over point. Last time he took to Morkel, now it's Steyn
that's a terrific ball seeking the base of middle, Tiwary clips it through to midwicket
this was full and outside off, Tiwary walks across and laps him to the right of short fine leg. That's a very brave shot, considering he was almost taking his eyes off the ball
back of a length, he swings off his feet and misses extravagantly outside off. Shades of that last over against NZ in the World T20
shortish and outside off, Tiwary has no intention of getting in line and cuts. Goes aerial and away to the sweeper
tossed up outside off, Tiwary launches it over the top of extra cover but he has not timed it at all
he's overstepped on the googly, JP steers it behind point for a single
oh my! He shuffled across and slog swept the flighted delivery into the stands behind midwicket. That was a majestic hit
flighted outside off, he hacks it away to deep midwicket
races down the track and smashes this over long-on. That's a pretty big blow in the context of the game
googly, tossed up just outside off. He mistimes a drive into the covers
good length ball with a hint of away shape, Tiwary gets an outside edge that wanders down to third man

Sammy pulls out the chainsaw after clinging on to a flat, hard hit from Pietersen. Steyn is on a hat-trick. It was full and KP moved his front leg to give himself room, he struck it well but has pinned down the man in the deep
slower ball on off stump, he goes for a slog but doesn't connect well enough. Rahul is at deep midwicket and holds on to a straight forward catch
full on off stump, KP drills it to the left of mid-off. Sammy dives a little early but he is tall enough to reach his hand out and cut the progress of the ball
just a little too full and KP has lashed it through point. Too fine for the sweeper to have any chance. Guess that's why he wanted the strike, he's feeling he's hitting them well
good length ball just outside off, DK punches into extra cover and his captain called him through for a suicidal run. Direct hit and he was out, DK had given up
slower ball and this time KP has mauled it miles into the crowd! Planted his front leg down and didn't bother with the niceties. Full-blooded swing of the bat and that brings us to the time out
bit of width outside off on this full delivery and Karthik pummels it down the ground. Drops short of long-off
overpitched just outside off, belted down to long-off
deceived by the offcutter. It was length too and in the slot to be smacked over the top but KP's swing misses
slower ball on middle, DK shuffles across and laps it. Doesn't bother keeping it down and it wasn't too far away from Rao who was running in from long leg
low full toss, KP punches it down the ground
he's been doing this a lot. Bowls with the seam up and ends up a low full toss which is driven through to deep extra cover
low full toss on off stump, pushed down the ground for a single
tossed up outside off, DK moves across and sweeps to deep midwicket
good length ball, turns the other way as he clips through midwicket
leading edge, but it doesn't carry to the bowler. This was drifted into the pads and he closed the face a little too early in his search for midwicket
comes down the track but Mishi's pulled the length back and KP has to block
skips down the track but can't beat Dhawan at extra cover. Crowd thinks it's a catch and goes up,
drifting in on middle and leg, KP looks to whip it away down leg but doesn't connect as well as he'd like
just a little short and DK cuts behind square. There is a sweeper out there though
good turn there for Karn. Drifts it in on middle and enjoys some help from the pitch as it rips right across his outside edge
drilled into the covers to get off the mark. Loads of power in the stroke as he stays leg side and punches the flighted ball
tossed up on off stump, Karn slips in his followthrough and that's a single down to long-off
fullish on the stumps, flicked away through midwicket
reverse swept off the back of the bat! Good length ball, he stretches forward and just helps it on its way.
slower ball, into the block hole. DK punches it down the ground but Sammy's reach is long enough to pull it down
full and wide, DK eases it to the right of a diving point. Gorgeous stroke
overpitched just outside off, Vijay gets under it but hasn't gotten the elevation. Hits it hard and flat and straight into the hands of Steyn at long-on. SRH fighting back
bit more bounce on this and he gets a thick outside edge that sails away to the third man boundary to bring up his fifty. Subdued celebrations though
this one grips the pitch and turns across him to hit his back thigh. Mild appeal but this was way too high
squares him up on off stump with one that is flat and pushed through on off stump
a couple of steps down the track to smother the spin on this tossed up delivery and block into the on side
lunges forward to block the flighted legspinner outside off

tossed up on off stump, De Kock goes for the slog sweep. This has gained considerable height but there is a man in the deep. Aaron Finch camps under it and holds on to a simple chance. Touches gloves with his partner as he walks back
flat delivery on middle, Vijay pulls to deep midwicket
flighted just outside off, but De Kock waits in the crease and cuts to the man in the deep
on a good length and Vijay nudges it to deep midwicket
he saw the batsman setting up for the reverse sweep and goes for the seam-up yorker. De Kock still manages to lace it to point
flatter now and tucking him up on middle, worked away through midwikcet
he's getting it off the middle now. This was tossed up amply on middle, Vijay steps out a touch and stays leg side of the ball to ease this over the ropes at extra cover. Pure class
picked the googly by the line of the ball on leg stump, clips the good length ball through to deep midwicket
straight of midwicket again and its the same pick up shot. Back of a length and just outside off, he is well balanced in the crease and finds the boundary
stand and delivery. It was length on off stump and Vijay has smashed it wide of midwicket. That bottom hand has loads of power
full and in the block hole, De Kock sets up for the slog but can't get under it enough. Inside edges to short fine leg
back of a length and it holds in the pitch a bit, Vijay pushes it down the ground for a well-judged single
digs it in quite short and Vijay is late on the hook. Gets a top edge that just about evades the keeper
that's a lovely ball. Makes Vijay waft at an outswinger pitched on a good length and in the corridor. Soundly beaten
there's the googly, spins away from De Kock's cut shot and he's not pleased that it wasn't a wide. Tight call that
this was seam-up and bowled from wide of the crease, Vijay lofts it down to long-off
loopy delivery on leg stump, think that was the googly. De Kock clips to long-on
flighted outside off, driven into the covers
swept off a good length but there is protection at deep square leg
lovely flight just outside off, Vijay comes forward and blocks
slog swept and no one is stopping that. This was flighted on off stump but he shuffles across and connects with elan. That's the time out
teases him with flight outside off, Vijay hammers it down to long-off
tossed up outside off, stands deep in the crease and carves it to deep point
tossed up just outside off, De Kock pulls out a reverse swat and beats short third man. Daredevils' change is paying rich dividends here
they've decided to play him off the back foot. This was on a fullish length on off stump, punched down to long-on
flighted on off stump, De Kock goes back and works through midwicket.
walks across and whips it to the left of short fine leg. Sammy's leisurely pace is working for Daredevils here.
full and on middle and leg, De Kock works it to deep micdwicket

oh, terrible work from Rao at short fine leg. This was a slow, low full toss which he sweeps. Comes at a lovely bounce to the fielder but he was getting ready to throw before he had control of the ball. Boundary gifted
slower ball fools him this time. Full and outside off, he moved to leg and looked to blast it away through extra, gets an inside edge that wanders towards short fine leg
shortish and outside off, cut towards point
presents a short one and he's slapped it behind point. It was pretty much the diet Dhawan was given and now Daredevils are getting their fill of it
slower through the air and flighted on off stump, Vijay comes forward and blocks with an open face
that's more like it. Tossed it up on off stump and keeps the batsman to a defensive
this one drifts down the pads, Vijay was looking to collect an easy boundary to fine leg but it was too far to reach
flat on middle and Vijay was backing away and cuts to cover
think this was the googly, nicely tossed up outside off and De Kock opens the face and picks up a single towards point. Soft hands
he was afraid of the batsman charging him and pushes this through short and flat. De Kock though was happily waiting on the back foot and pulls it one-bounce to the square leg boundary
nice and tight on leg stump, Vijay picks it away to deep midwicket
he won't be smiling after this. It was full on off stump but De Kock had moved across and flicked it to the long leg boundary. Looked completely at ease playing that
not quite short enough to cut there. Cross-seamer doesn't rise as high and sneaks under the bat. Steyn flashes a smirk at de Kock
shortish and angled into the pads, flicked into midwicket
shortish on middle, Vijay was looking for it to be a little more shorter and gets a bit of leading edge. Doesn't carry to the bowler
shortish and outside off, he steers it to point and forgets it's Warner down there. Swoops on the ball and forces Vijay to back track.
shortish on middle, De Kock taps it behind point
times this to perfection. He backed away and that helped him gain enough room to hoist it over extra cover.
skips down the track and gets a thick leading edge that lobs point and short third man.
tries to open up the off side by making room for himself, but Venu follows him. Cut through point
this is on a good length and is picked away in front of midwicket. Warner scurries in from deep midwicket and keeps it to a single. That's incredibly good fielding
moves outside leg and creams this flighted ball to mid-off
flighted on leg stump, worked away to the left of mid-on
length ball outside off, he looks to cart it over midwicket but miscues it
excellent hands from Vijay. Took it from middle and a wristy flick later the ball was skimming down to the square leg boundary
shortish and just outside off, De Kock drops and runs to point but I suspect had Warner's underarmed throw hit he would have been short. Dived and threw in one action, that's wonderful work
back of a length and on the body, Vijay works it behind square leg
he's good down the ground and this was in the slot. Length with a bit of room to free the arms and Vijay has launched it towards the sightscreen. Quite elegant
just back of a good length on off stump, Vijay is kept to a block down the pitch
back of a length and he's beaten for pace as he looks to flick. De Kock pulls him through for the single as the ball lobs over to point
gets a thick outside edge that wanders off to deep third man, away swing off the fuller delivery

fullish and outside off, Vijay eases it to the left of mid-off and he sets off for a single. Steyn was moving to back up and in the process cuts Vijay's path and had that hit direct he would have been out. They shake hands after though, so no harm done
a little away shape outside off, Vijay is squared up as he blocks into the covers
back of a length and keeping him tucked up on middle, De Kock works it down to short fine leg
how bout that. It's length on middle and leg and he's slapped it down the ground. Came back at the bowler uppishly but it was struck too well for Steyn to have a chance
back of a length and outside off, Vijay presents an open face to point
back of a length and outside off, De Kock taps to point and seeks a single. But Vijay is wary of Warner in that region. Sends him back but the overthrow allows the score to tick
goes full and a little too wide outside off, De Kock doesn't bother with it
comes forward and works it to the left of midwicket. Tight single, but well done in the end
just short of a good length on off stump, Vijay blocks
the away shape has Vijay worried. He was looking to defend first, then wants to pull his bat away and ends up under edging it to the keeper
nice length and teasing just outside off. De Kock gets a thick outside edge to deep third man
